articles.title: Semenyo's Audacious Back-Flick Seals FA Cup Glory for Manchester City
articles.summary: Antoine Semenyo's stunning back-flick goal gave Manchester City a 1-0 win over Chelsea in the FA Cup final at Wembley. The victory keeps City's treble hopes alive, though they trail Arsenal in the Premier League title race.

articles.title: LIRR Strike Paralyzes Commute for 250,000 as Unions and MTA Deadlock
articles.summary: A strike by unionized workers shut down the Long Island Rail Road on Saturday, affecting 250,000 daily riders. Negotiations over pay and health premiums have stalled, with no new talks scheduled.

articles.title: After a Surge in Rural Applicants, Elite Colleges Face an Enrollment Challenge
articles.summary: The STARS College Network has boosted rural applications to selective schools by 15%, but getting those students to enroll and graduate remains tough. Cultural and financial barriers, plus distrust of higher education, are key obstacles.
